Mixed-precision re-quantisation of the pinned bf16 head (EigenLabs/Qwen3.8-27B-MTP-bf16): the fc input-fusion projection (5120x10240, the head's common input projection whose quantisation error propagates into every MTP layer) stays bf16 verbatim; the remaining seven 2D Linear weights (attention q/k/v/o, MLP gate/up/down) are 4-bit affine group-64 with MLX 0.32.0 mx.quantize(group_size=64, bits=4) -- byte-identical packing/scales/biases to the promoted dwsdubey RTN head for those layers. The seven 1D norm tensors stay bf16. sha256 is the tree digest over the sorted '<sha256>  model.safetensors
' manifest per the documented rule; bytes is the fetched file size. Local paired measurement (128-token window, M3): acceptance 0.9911 / mean_draft_len 6.22 -- equal to the full-bf16 head and above the all-4-bit RTN head's 0.9821 / 5.89 -- at 314 MB vs 849 MB (bf16) / 239 MB (all-4-bit). The head only proposes; the pinned target re-verifies every emitted token against the hidden serial trajectory.
